"All Followers of Set" implies all the controlled FoS. Who else *could* it
apply to? You do not put the card into play, the referendum card in the ash
heap does not trigger upon another FoS entering play, and there is no card
text indicating lasting effects, out-of-play FoS, or any other effects
beyond all the controlled FoS, if any.

those affected being all the controlled FoS at the time the referendum is
successful.

My idea (presented in pieces just for clarity):
1) Any action being performed which creates a new vampire inherits the
sect of the acting vampire, unless otherwise specified in card text.

2) Any action being performed which changes the clan of a vampire
inherits the "Default Sect" of that clan, unless otherwise specified
in card text.

3) Any effect which creates a new vampire which is not part of an action
inherits the Default Sect of the clan, unless otherwise specified by
card text.

4) A slight change to the texts of the four sect-changing votes.
Something like this (using Ravnos Acceptance as an example):

"If this <referendum> is successful, all non-Anarch Independent
Ravnos are considered to be Camarilla vampires instead."

Isn't that simple? It gets around special cases like Anka.
And doesn't mess with Anarchs. And if you Go Anarch you still
become Independent.

What are the problems with this (and I'm sure there are some)?

4) is piecemeal. It doesn't address the underlying problem - it just
provides a patch for that particular pairing (Anarch vs. RA). What
happens when a new attribute is introduced similar to Anarch? Or a
new equipment card like the Writ of Disapproval - the bearer is
considered Independent?

It also isn't written to overcome 1.6.1.5. (much like the current text
doesn't overcome 1.6.1.5.).

Also note that 2) doesn't quite stretch over Revelations of the Sire
(not that it's any worse than the current, though). Anka revealing
herself as the sire of a Caitiff turns the Caitiff into an Independent
Ravnos (which then quickly becomes a Camarilla Ravnos if RA is in
effect per 4 above), not a Sabbat Ravnos.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>> "If this <referendum> is successful, all non-Anarch Independent
>> Ravnos are considered to be Camarilla vampires instead."
>>
>> Isn't that simple? It gets around special cases like Anka.
>> And doesn't mess with Anarchs. And if you Go Anarch you still
>> become Independent.
>
>4) is piecemeal. It doesn't address the underlying problem - it just
>provides a patch for that particular pairing (Anarch vs. RA). What
>happens when a new attribute is introduced similar to Anarch? Or a
>new equipment card like the Writ of Disapproval - the bearer is
>considered Independent?

How about something like:

"Put this card into play. The Default Sect for Clan <Ravnos> is Camarilla. When
a <Ravnos> vampire enters play she becomes Camarilla."

This would allow future Ravnos to become Camarilla as well and seems to
interact fine with the Anarch trait. A few flaws:

#1. This current mechanism involves putting the card into play (which may or
may not be good). It does allow a means with which to remove the card (oust the
controlling player). If you don't like this you can just add a "for the
remainder of the game" clause to each of the parts.

#2. There are a few corner cases where this card might have some minor
unforeseen consequences (i.e. a Banished Anarch Ravnos is brought back into
play or an Anarch Ravnos is contested and returns to play) but they are either
corner-case enough or can simply be worked around (i.e. explicitly exempt
vampires returning to play after contesting, etc.).

Just an idea.

Halcyan 2
